plan.selection: Highest positive expected net return, one H/D/A selection per match; same selection across methods. Robust method may abstain.
plan.robust: Quarter of worst-case binary Kelly with selected probability in [max(0,p-0.02),min(1,p+0.02)]. Fixed ambiguity radius; not an estimated confidence interval or tuned optimum.
plan.settlement: All same-date stakes use opening daily bankroll. Scale proportionally to 10% total exposure. Settle together at day end. Fractional amounts without minimum stake/rounding. No fees, taxes or execution limits.
plan.scope: Every saved equal/recency-weighted, raw/calibrated model; independent $1000 bankroll for each split and league. All-league portfolio simulated separately, not a sum of league profits. UI manual filters do not apply.
plan.limitations: Train is in-sample, not evidence of future profitability. Test 2022–23 previously inspected. Historical actual lineups and Bet365 prices; not Winner returns. Original duplicate test fixture retained for matched comparisons. Daily drawdown excludes intraday swings.
